article.hook: You keep pushing, but the world feels like it’s asking for patience instead of speed. Mars moving through Taurus makes drive dig in deep, not sprint out fast. Watch how you handle the drag between desire and delay.
article.lived: For about six weeks, action doesn’t race ahead - it grinds forward like a hand tool wearing a groove into wood. You might find yourself turning tasks into rituals, repeating efforts until muscle memory owns the job. It’s not about bursts of energy but the quiet accumulation of progress, even if it feels slow to anyone watching.
article.turn: The same grip that builds stamina can lock you into a stubborn loop. When the plan falters, instead of pivoting, you dig your heels in, turning resistance into passive aggression or silent refusal. Persistence is a weapon only when it leads somewhere new; otherwise, it’s just digging a deeper hole.
moves: Pick one physical task and finish it in a way that can’t be undone this week.
Say exactly what you want before you start pushing harder.
If a plan stalls for two days, make a clear decision to shift or stop.
